subject: part5 MM output aggregate the first and second days

messages.author: c2b608cf1a4e77a3
messages.subject: part5 MM output aggregate the first and second days
parts:
Hello colleagues,

I have observed that, for all participants,  the first incomplete day of measurement is being aggregated to the second day and analysed as a single day according to part5 midnight-midnight output. 

The GGIR shell function included the argument strategy=1, which would include the first incomplete day. However,  my understanding is that these incomplete days would be excluded from part5 as they were in part2 (see examples below). The default for "minimum_MM_length.part5" would also prevent this from happening.

Please check the screenshots of day_summaries of p2 and p5 outputs for the same participant. Config file is attached.

part5_MM_daysummary


Thank you for your support,
Marcus

messages.author: 05de4f382b390d3d
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Re: part5 MM output aggregate the first and second days
parts:
Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the files. I found the issue, it was a minor bug that only appeared when more than one set of thresholds has been defined. If you look at your first report generated in part 5 (i.e., L36.5M201.4V707), you should see that this one is correct, but the separation of the first and second day failed from the second iteration onwards.

I have fixed this in a new branch in github, to test and use this, please do this:

install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("wadpac/GGIR", ref = "issue775_part5_firstday")

library(GGIR)
GGIR(here your standard script to run GGIR)
